description.value:
A capacity attachment: it adds rounds to the weapon's base capacity, by weapon type: Pistol (all) +38, SMG (all) +40, Crossbow +19, Shotgun +24, Assault Rifle +50, Machine Gun +80, Sniper Rifle +16, Grenade Launcher +8, Rocket Launcher +4.

One capacity attachment per weapon. Crossbows can take one too; a loaded crossbow magazine holds one arrow type (you can still hand-load another with a free hand).

Item Compendium (2070) • Attachments & Mods
